semantics.ACT_outcomes: Unique actual generated ACT origins with returned native R184_ACT outcomes; includes faults.
semantics.accepted: Accepted among newly scored caption IDs; denominator is newly scored IDs, not ACTs or parsed occurrences.
semantics.coverage: Native-returned receipts at the cut; in-flight scorer outcomes not yet in the native journal remain pending.
semantics.examples: Three user-requested exact own ACT candidate spans only; no reference caption panel accessed.
semantics.hourly: Partial first-life-hour window; not a completed-hour rate or extrapolated throughput.
semantics.new_pixels: Unique pixel IDs on accepted, nonreplayed results whose actual status is new_pixel.
semantics.newly_scored: Unique per-life submission IDs with ok=true, accepted boolean, replayed=false; never PUBLISHED alone.
semantics.opportunities: Completed native R223_CAPTION_OPPORTUNITY records with distinct, verified member ACTs; not inferred cycles.
semantics.parsed: Verified source-span caption occurrences extracted by the scorer parser; cached-caption occurrences may be present.
semantics.parser_faults: Contemporaneous scorer format_fault; no-caption/ambiguity/resource-bound columns are overlapping subsets.
semantics.transport: Unique ACT origins with explicit transport failure or unknown outcome. Parser activity is unknown for failed transport.
